scope: Pinned model input/output byte and channel order. Static native instruction/data-flow evidence; no device execution or camera colorimetry claim.

natural.input_channel_contract: Given an RGBA face crop, model channels are RGB in that order; no RGB/BGR swap.
natural.normal_blit_format: Converted CPU and GPU-readback branches normalize output format0/RGBA with four bytes per pixel.
normal_blit_proof: 0xcae934..984 wraps the resulting source bytes as CV_8UC4; configured FaceAlign then ImageTransform code1 drops alpha without reordering.
natural.passthrough_limit: TextureBlit also has a borrowed/direct-buffer branch0xc36124..c3623c that preserves caller format metadata. Natural code1 itself does not convert a BGRA caller buffer into RGB. An external replacement must explicitly supply/normalize RGBA; no all-runtime-format guarantee is inferred.
natural.output_channel_contract: Model channels0,1,2,3 become R,G,B,A in the Image object.
output_proof: Lua getNHImageInfo image getter0xb4c118 uses postprocess dtype/channel fields; CV_8UC4=0x18 dispatch0xb4c180..b4c1b0 chooses AMG RGBA8Unorm=43.
The image borrows the original interleaved output pointer via0xe4b100 ->Image.loadwithoutcpy; no channel permutation occurs in this wrapper.
The same getter has a CV_32FC4=0x1d ->RGBA32Sfloat branch; this is a type-support fact, not evidence current app chooses it.

purity.input_channel_contract: All four supported image buffer formats (RGBA,BGRA,BGR,RGB) become RGB model channels.

purity.output_channel_contract: Model channels0,1,2,3 become R,G,B,A in the Image object.

spatial_order.color_conversion: Each pixel stays at its row/column; alpha removal/red-blue swap has no geometric rotation, transpose or vertical flip.
spatial_order.model_tensor_boundary: Data conversion and postprocess preserve spatial order; face affine alignment and caller orientation are separate transforms.
spatial_order.runtime_orientation: TextureBlit combines runtime rotation metadata modulo4 at0xc37208..10 and carries flip/rotation fields. Static constants cannot establish one phone orientation; do not hardcode90degrees or an unconditional vertical flip.

implementation_guidance: For an owned high-quality pipeline, pass a well-defined RGBA/RGB working image to the model preparation boundary; use RGB model channels for both styles.
Preserve floating-point RGB values through normalization and map the four outputs as RGBA; legacy U8 postconvert is not necessary to establish channel semantics.
This does not establish input RGB primaries, transfer function, full/limited YUV range, alpha premultiplication, HDR training/support, or whole-image affine sampler equivalence.
limitations: Static analysis of pinned v5.6.2 native libraries, not an observed current device session.
RGBA ordering is distinct from colorimetry: these results cannot alone justify applying an SDR-trained network directly to HLG/PQ scene values.
Full native image/camera/style/HDR-save parity remains outside this evidence.
